versions.changelog:
Initial release of keyboardhero-skill.

- Launch a standalone web-based typing game for beginners, fully offline and zero-dependency (HTML/CSS/JS).
- Includes 18-level standard touch typing tutorial, rhythm mode, typing racer, bomb defuse, five-lane tower defense, hero collection, and ranking system.
- All features work by simply opening index.html; user progress is saved locally.
- The skill is designed for local or online play, with clear entry points for each game mode from the main menu.
- No external resources, network access, or API keys required—fully self-contained experience.
